objective: Turn Calix's live.gnu6.calix.Refresh signal into a desktop notification without a shell pipeline: a small session-bus bridge that links libdbus, ships as a packaged user service, and is installed without being enabled.
scope: calix-notify is a separate executable, not a CLI mode: the daemon must not inherit a terminal or a desktop dependency
the bridge links libdbus directly and matches type='signal',interface='live.gnu6.calix',member='Refresh',path='/live/gnu6/calix/Notifications'
the refresh signal becomes one org.freedesktop.Notifications.Notify call with app_name Calix, app_icon live.gnu6.calix and a 5s expiry
the session bus address is taken from DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS, otherwise from an absolute XDG_RUNTIME_DIR; the bridge never autolaunches a bus
a dropped bus exits the process so the systemd unit restarts it inside its StartLimit window
the package installs /usr/lib/calix/calix-notify, the /usr/bin/calix-notify symlink and calix-notify.service, and now depends on dbus
the release artifact carries the same three files
both user units stay installed and disabled

cases: session bus address prefers the explicit environment and falls back to XDG
only the Calix Refresh signal is accepted
notification method call is a complete Notify message

end_to_end.method: a private dbus-daemon, dbus-monitor on org.freedesktop.Notifications.Notify, the bridge subscribed to the signal, then dbus-send of the exact signal calix sends
end_to_end.refresh_signal: one Notify call with app_name Calix, replaces_id 0, app_icon live.gnu6.calix, summary 'Package state changed', empty actions and hints, expire_timeout 5000

failure_paths.no_session_bus: exit 1 with 'no session bus (DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR are unset)' when neither is set
failure_paths.bus_disconnect: exit 1 with SessionBusDisconnected when the bus is killed under the bridge

packaging.package_staging: the package() function was staged against the built binaries: usr/lib/calix/calix-notify, usr/bin/calix-notify -> /usr/lib/calix/calix-notify and usr/lib/systemd/user/calix-notify.service are all present
packaging.unit_syntax: pass with ExecStart substituted with /bin/true, because the install path only exists after package extraction
packaging.dbus_dependency: dbus added to depends; the container base image already ships dbus 1.16.2 with pkgconfig, and ci-setup now installs it explicitly

known_gaps: The bridge was exercised against a private dbus-daemon, not against a live desktop notification daemon: no notification daemon is installed on this host, so the Notify call was observed on the bus rather than rendered.

The user unit was not enabled on the live system. Enabling a user unit and installing the package need an interactive polkit session, so the unit is validated by syntax check and package staging only.
The full makepkg build was not repeated for this change: the package() function was staged directly against the built binaries, and the release-artifact step was mirrored in the workflow.
calix-notify is not part of the published v0.2.0 artifact: that tag predates this commit.
